comparison.objective: Remove a rock from beneath a high-centred rover and restore the rover to its wheels; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Supporting or manipulating a bulky rover while extracting an obstruction versus small-tool engagement, collar tuning, counterholding, locking, and impact cycling.
comparison.success_condition: Rover restored upright without dragging or dropping; the record supplies no numeric displacement, damage, stability, or hold thresholds. Candidate has explicit operating-envelope and failure gates.
comparison.reason: Obstacle extraction and vehicle recovery do not test adjustment of a damping mechanism or empirical stopping-response tuning.
